sql: SELECT count(*) rows,count(distinct company_id) companies,count(distinct company_id||date_joined) id_dates FROM companies_dates
SELECT count(*) rows,count(distinct company_id) companies,count(distinct company_id||industry) id_industries FROM companies_industries

WITH dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,date_joined,year_founded FROM companies_dates), industries AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,industry FROM companies_industries), new_companies AS (SELECT d.company_id,CAST(strftime('%Y',d.date_joined) AS INTEGER) year,i.industry FROM dates d JOIN industries i USING(company_id) WHERE d.date_joined>='2019-01-01' AND d.date_joined<'2022-01-01'), totals AS (SELECT industry,count(distinct company_id) total FROM new_companies GROUP BY industry) SELECT industry,total,total/3.0 average_new_companies FROM totals ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

WITH dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,date_joined,year_founded FROM companies_dates), industries AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,industry FROM companies_industries), new_companies AS (SELECT d.company_id,CAST(strftime('%Y',d.date_joined) AS INTEGER) year,i.industry FROM dates d JOIN industries i USING(company_id) WHERE d.date_joined>='2019-01-01' AND d.date_joined<'2022-01-01'), totals AS (SELECT industry,count(distinct company_id) total FROM new_companies GROUP BY industry) SELECT year,industry,count(distinct company_id) n FROM new_companies GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY year,n DESC

WITH dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,date_joined,year_founded FROM companies_dates), industries AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,industry FROM companies_industries), new_companies AS (SELECT d.company_id,CAST(strftime('%Y',d.date_joined) AS INTEGER) year,i.industry FROM dates d JOIN industries i USING(company_id) WHERE d.date_joined>='2019-01-01' AND d.date_joined<'2022-01-01'), totals AS (SELECT industry,count(distinct company_id) total FROM new_companies GROUP BY industry) SELECT industry,count(distinct d.company_id) founded_total FROM dates d JOIN industries i USING(company_id) WHERE year_founded BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021 GROUP BY industry ORDER BY founded_total DESC LIMIT 5

WITH dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,date_joined,year_founded FROM companies_dates), industries AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,industry FROM companies_industries), new_companies AS (SELECT d.company_id,CAST(strftime('%Y',d.date_joined) AS INTEGER) year,i.industry FROM dates d JOIN industries i USING(company_id) WHERE d.date_joined>='2019-01-01' AND d.date_joined<'2022-01-01'), totals AS (SELECT industry,count(distinct company_id) total FROM new_companies GROUP BY industry) SELECT industry,total/3.0 average_new_companies FROM totals ORDER BY total DESC,industry LIMIT 1

SELECT substr(d.date_joined,1,4) year,count(*) raw_count,count(distinct d.company_id) distinct_companies FROM companies_dates d JOIN companies_industries i USING(company_id) WHERE i.industry='Fintech' AND d.date_joined>='2019-01-01' AND d.date_joined<'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.company_id,d.date_joined,count(*) joined_copies FROM companies_dates d JOIN companies_industries i USING(company_id) WHERE i.industry='Fintech' AND d.date_joined>='2019-01-01' AND d.date_joined<'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM companies_dates) date_rows,(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM companies_dates)) distinct_date_rows,(SELECT count(*) FROM companies_industries) industry_rows,(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM companies_industries)) distinct_industry_rows

WITH dates AS (SELECT company_id,date_joined,year_founded FROM companies_dates), industries AS (SELECT company_id,industry FROM companies_industries), new_companies AS (SELECT d.company_id,CAST(strftime('%Y',d.date_joined) AS INTEGER) year,i.industry FROM dates d JOIN industries i USING(company_id) WHERE d.date_joined>='2019-01-01' AND d.date_joined<'2022-01-01'), totals AS (SELECT industry,count(*) total FROM new_companies GROUP BY industry) SELECT industry,total,round(total/3.0,2) answer FROM totals ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3

WITH dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,date_joined,year_founded FROM companies_dates), industries AS (SELECT DISTINCT company_id,industry FROM companies_industries), new_companies AS (SELECT d.company_id,CAST(strftime('%Y',d.date_joined) AS INTEGER) year,i.industry FROM dates d JOIN industries i USING(company_id) WHERE d.date_joined>='2019-01-01' AND d.date_joined<'2022-01-01'), totals AS (SELECT industry,count(distinct company_id) total FROM new_companies GROUP BY industry) SELECT avg(n) changing_year_top FROM (SELECT year,max(n) n FROM (SELECT year,industry,count(distinct company_id) n FROM new_companies GROUP BY 1,2) GROUP BY year)
